title: YouTube / Netflix
prompt: Design a video platform like YouTube: creators upload videos, which are processed into multiple resolutions, and viewers around the world stream them smoothly on any device and network.
functionalReqs: Video metadata, search by title, view counts
nonFunctionalReqs: Smooth playback worldwide (low startup time, minimal buffering)
Processing can take minutes; playback cannot lag

scale.qps: ~500 hours of video uploaded per minute; ~100K concurrent stream starts/s at peak
scale.storage: ~1 GB per hour per rendition set → ~1 PB/day new storage
scale.notes: Egress dominates cost: CDN is essential

deepDives: Transcoding DAG and parallel chunk encoding
